_README: REAL-HARDWARE A6-EC servo config for the viam:ethercat:a6-servo motor model --
the companion to etc/a6-servo.example.json (sim-only) and etc/a6-minimal.example.json
(the leanest form). This is the artifact real bring-up starts from: plug in,
The encoder/gear/current values below MUST be verified against THIS drive's ESI
file and the motor nameplate before applying power. A wrong counts_per_rev will
command the motor incorrectly. require_realtime is true here -- the host needs
#18: there is NO control_mode and NO rxpdo/txpdo. The driver is ALWAYS
switch-capable (each motor API call ensures its own mode at runtime: GoTo/GoFor
-> PP, SetRPM -> PV) and defines ONE fixed CiA402 superset PDO map itself, using
CONFIRM (per the A6 ESI) that the drive permits CoE PDO remap on these indices.
name: servo

attributes._comment_model: #15 item 2: the A6 uses the viam:ethercat:a6-servo model -- an A6ServoDriver subclass that supplies the three A6 residuals in CODE (vendor fault-reset 0x2031:01=1, the no-SYNC0 code 0x8700/Er74.1, and its 0x603F gloss). Those are NOT config attributes. A generic non-A6 CiA402 drive uses viam:ethercat:servo instead.
attributes._comment_bus: interface = the host NIC bound to the EtherCAT segment (CONFIRM: `ip link`). slave = 1-based ring position of the A6.
attributes._comment_motor: CONFIRM against the MOTOR nameplate (these are motor-, not drive-, specific): rated speed, rated current, peak current.
attributes._comment_kinematics: counts_per_rev = 2^17 = 131072 (A6 single-turn encoder resolution -- CONFIRM the encoder bits on the nameplate/ESI). gear_ratio = motor revs per output rev (CONFIRM the mechanical reduction; 1.0 = direct drive).
attributes._comment_rt: require_realtime=true: hard-fail if SCHED_FIFO is unavailable (a real drive must run RT). loop_rate_hz <= 1000. rt_priority 1..99. use_distributed_clocks=true is REQUIRED for the A6 (it supports ONLY DC sync; without SYNC0 it faults out of OP -- Er74.1, WKC->0). The SYNC0 cycle = 1e9/loop_rate_hz MUST be an integer multiple of 250us for the A6 -> loop_rate_hz in {1000,500,250,...}; 1000 Hz = 1 ms = 4x250us. sync_cycle_granularity_ns=250000 DECLARES that 250us granularity so a bad rate is rejected at CONFIG time with the valid alternatives, instead of the drive faulting cryptically at OP entry (Er74.0).
attributes._comment_tuning: reached/is_moving is POSITION-STABILITY based (#59): stopped/reached = actual position (0x6064) not changing beyond position_tolerance_counts over N cycles -- NOT a velocity threshold, so there is NO velocity-noise-floor tuning to do (the A6's 0x606C carries a +/-2000-4000 c/s noise floor; see a6-quirks Q13). position_tolerance_counts is OPTIONAL, default = counts_per_rev/720 (~0.5 deg); the 200 below is an explicit example (~0.55 deg at 131072 c/rev).
